title: Read explicitly selected engineering records
description: Read explicit current operational scope from one coherent associated snapshot, preserving complete selected meaning, explicit absence and current support.
inputs: Explicit project, Change and supported context or item query.
outputs: Complete selected current content, coherent record contract/revision and bounded selector index where applicable.
Explicit absent, unavailable, conflicting or failed outcome.
behavior: Resolve current typed records from one coherent SQLite snapshot; maintenance exclusion yields explicit unavailability or busy.
Apply only declared selectors; no inferred authority or automatic next activity.
Return complete selected assessment, evidence, rationale and support without unrelated bodies.
Distinguish omitted selections, absent accounts, unavailable retained payloads and invalid stores.
Serialize the bounded complete selected result before output; no cursor or field-projection protocol is implied.
Reads never initialize, migrate, choose maintenance recovery or edit judgments; SQLite may establish its determined transaction outcome.

failure_behavior.condition: Selected scope is absent, invalid, unavailable or oversized.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return explicit scoped failure or absence without truncation, invented success or silent legacy fallback.
